tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that the ArcGIS Pro bridge is reachable and see which project it is attached to.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List every command the connected bridge supports, grouped by area. Use this to discover functionality beyond the named tools.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Self-check the connection: ArcGIS Pro version, licence, open project, active map, open map view and write access. Run this first when something does not work.

tools.name: get_arcgis_info
tools.description: ArcGIS Pro version, licence level, available extensions and the current project path.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Project paths, default geodatabase and toolbox, maps, layouts, folder and database connections.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the ArcGIS Pro project (.aprx), or save a copy elsewhere.

save_as_path.description: Optional path for a copy; the open project is left untouched.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: List all maps and scenes with coordinate system and layer counts.

tools.name: activate_map
tools.description: Open/activate a map's view in the ArcGIS Pro UI. Needed before camera commands and export_map_view.

tools.name: get_map_extent
tools.description: The combined extent of all data layers in a map.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: get_layers
tools.description: List the layers (with draw order and group nesting) and standalone tables in a map. Start here to see what is in the project.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: get_layer_info
tools.description: Full detail for one layer: data source, coordinate system, extent, fields, feature count, renderer and label state.

layer_name.description: Layer or table name as shown by get_layers, or a full dataset path.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: rename_layer
tools.description: Rename a layer in the table of contents.

layer_name.description: Layer or table name as shown by get_layers, or a full dataset path.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: set_layer_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide one layer, several layers, or every layer in the map.

visible.description: True to show, False to hide.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: set_layer_transparency
tools.description: Set layer transparency (0 = opaque, 100 = fully transparent).

layer_name.description: Layer or table name as shown by get_layers, or a full dataset path.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: set_definition_query
tools.description: Set a layer's definition query (SQL where clause). Empty string clears it.

layer_name.description: Layer or table name as shown by get_layers, or a full dataset path.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: get_broken_layers
tools.description: List layers across all maps whose data source is missing.

tools.name: run_geoprocessing_tool
tools.description: Run any arcpy geoprocessing tool -- the universal escape hatch for analysis. Layer names resolve to live layers so selections and definition queries apply. Call describe_geoprocessing_tool first if the parameter names are not known.

add_to_map.description: Add the tool's outputs to the map.

checkout_extension.description: Extension to check out for this run, e.g. "Spatial" or "3D".

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: list_geoprocessing_tools
tools.description: Search the available geoprocessing tools by name.

toolbox.description: Restrict to one toolbox alias, e.g. "analysis" or "management".

tools.name: list_toolboxes
tools.description: List the arcpy toolbox modules and any toolboxes in the project.

tools.name: describe_geoprocessing_tool
tools.description: Get a tool's parameters, data types, defaults and usage text before running it.

tools.name: check_extension
tools.description: Check, and optionally check out, an ArcGIS extension licence.

checkout.description: Check the licence out if it is available.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Messages from the most recent geoprocessing operation.

tools.name: get_map_view
tools.description: Current camera position: centre, scale, rotation and visible extent. Requires the map's tab to be open in ArcGIS Pro.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: set_map_view
tools.description: Move the map view: set an extent, a centre point, a scale and/or a rotation.

epsg.description: WKID the extent coordinates are in.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: export_map_view
tools.description: Render the map view to PNG and return the image so it can be looked at -- the way to visually check a map. Requires the map's tab to be open in ArcGIS Pro.

output_path.description: Optional file to save to; omit for a temporary image.

zoom_to_layer.description: Zoom to this layer before exporting.

map_name.description: Map to act on; defaults to the active map.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: List the print layouts with page size and element counts.

tools.name: get_layout_info
tools.description: Inspect a layout: page setup and every element with position and size.

tools.name: set_map_frame_extent
tools.description: Point a layout's map frame at a layer, an extent or a scale.

layer_name.description: Zoom the frame to this layer.

selection_only.description: Zoom to the layer's selected features only.

zoom_to_all.description: Zoom to all layers in the frame's map.

tools.name: set_layout_element
tools.description: Move, resize, rename, hide or change the text of any layout element.

tools.name: export_layout
tools.description: Export a layout to PDF / PNG / JPEG / SVG / TIFF. PNG and JPEG come back as an inline image so the result can be checked.

output_path.description: Output file; the format follows the extension.

tools.name: preview_layout
tools.description: Render a layout to a temporary image and return it, without writing a file -- use it to visually check a layout while building it.

tools.name: activate_layout
tools.description: 在当前Pro窗口打开指定本地布局。

tools.name: get_raster_palette
tools.description: 读取本地栅格六级配色

tools.name: set_raster_palette
tools.description: 修改本地六级栅格配色，保留分类值与级界
